costs.title: What care usually costs without insurance
costs.subtitle: These are rough national ranges, not prices for any specific clinic. Sliding-scale clinics in this app are often much cheaper. Always call ahead to confirm your cost.
costs.primaryCareSub: Average around $160 nationwide. Retail and urgent care clinics often $80–250.
costs.labsSub: The same test can cost 3–10× more at a hospital. Always ask for the cash/self-pay price.
costs.fqhcSub: For low-income uninsured patients, often very little — or free. This is what most clinics in this app offer.
costs.whyBody: An ER visit without insurance averages about $2,715 — more than 10× a primary care visit. A community clinic can handle most non-emergencies for a fraction of that.
costs.disclaimer: Prices vary by region and provider and change over time. This is general information, not a quote or medical advice. Ranges based on 2025–2026 self-pay data. Call the clinic to confirm your cost.
costs.helpEntrySub: National price ranges for self-pay patients

about.emergencyBody: This app is not for medical emergencies. If this is an emergency, call 911 or go to the nearest emergency room.
about.appDescription: Wellcott helps you find community health centers across the U.S. that accept self-pay and sliding-scale patients — no insurance required.
about.bringTitle: What to bring to your first visit
about.bringIncome: Proof of income (recent pay stub or benefits letter) — needed for the lowest sliding-scale fee
about.bringAddress: Proof of address (a utility bill or any mail)
about.bringMeds: A list of medications you take
about.bringNote: Without proof of income, a clinic may charge its standard rate until you can verify. If you don't have these, most clinics will still see you.
about.disclaimer1: Information is for reference only — not medical or legal advice.
about.disclaimer2: Prices vary. Most clinics use a sliding scale based on income — always call ahead to confirm.
about.disclaimer3: Federally funded health centers must see you regardless of insurance or ability to pay.
about.disclaimer4: Prescription savings are provided via SingleCare and are not insurance. We may earn a referral fee.
